About Luo

 

Luo is one of the fastest-growing FX and cross-border payments companies in Africa. We help African businesses pay their international suppliers faster, more transparently, and more competitively than traditional solutions.

 

After becoming a leading player in a few markets in record time, we are looking to grow our engineering team and keep expanding the financial infrastructure for FX and cross-border payments in Africa.

 

Role overview

 

As Infrastructure & Security Lead, you will join a small team of experienced engineers and be responsible for evolving our cloud infrastructure and its security controls. You will work directly with our CTO to build the foundations that keep LuoPay secure, reliable, and compliant as we scale. The scope covers our GCP infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, security tooling, as well as the security and compliance program that regulators, partners, and customers depend on.

 

Key responsibilities

  • Analyze our infrastructure and map security risks.

  • Write clear, concise design documents to share infrastructure targets with the rest of the engineering team.

  • Use Terraform to evolve our GCP infrastructure.

  • Use GCP-native security tooling to protect our network, services and databases within GCP.

  • Automate security testing within our delivery pipelines.

  • Research and onboard new tools to improve our reliability and security posture.

  • Work alongside our CTO to implement our security and compliance framework.

 

What we are looking for

  • 10+ years of tech engineering experience

  • Strong experience building cloud infrastructure, managing cloud security and writing Terraform code.

  • Experience within GCP is highly appreciated, though we value fundamental engineering skills over any knowledge of a specific tech stack.

  • Strong appetite for security focused technical work.

  • Wide technical curiosity and willingness to contribute to many different parts of our stack: IAM, networking, governance, CI/CD, observability, APIs and web security.

  • Previous experience working in small, fast-paced teams.

  • Previous experience building cloud infrastructure within a regulated industry is appreciated.

  • Previous experience participating in the implementation of ISO27001 or SOC2 compliance is appreciated.

 

Why join us

  • Play a key role in building the fintech infrastructure that unlocks international payments for businesses in Africa.

  • Work alongside a small team of senior engineers within a fast-paced, growing startup.

  • Be exposed to an an usual breadth of technical responsibilities, with room to grow.

  • Be given the room and support to build a state-of-the art security program in a regulated industry.

  • Continuously experiment with LLMs to expand the boundaries of your impact.

data.description:
Your journey

ROMEO is the queer company behind the legendary ROMEO dating app, one of Europe’s longest-standing dating platforms for queer communities. We are looking for a Product Owner to join our Product team in Berlin and help shape how ideas and product requirements make their way into the hands of millions of users.

In this delivery-focused role, you will work closely with Product Management, Design, Engineering, QA and BI to turn product priorities into clear, actionable work for our development teams. It is a great opportunity to grow your product skills while taking real ownership of the day-to-day delivery process.


Your typical day

  • Support the Product Management team in refining product requirements and translating approved PRDs into implementation-ready epics, user stories and tickets.
  • Ensure user stories have clear acceptance criteria and are sufficiently refined before entering development.
  • Maintain and order the backlog according to priorities set by product leadership.
  • Take part in regular and ad hoc meetings to clarify product requirements with development, design and other delivery teams.
  • Support our two-week delivery cycle by ensuring development teams have the information and decisions they need to proceed.
  • Identify missing requirements, dependencies, open decisions and blockers early, and escalate them to Product or Delivery.
  • Work closely with QA to communicate product and release priorities, clarify acceptance criteria, and support defect triage and release-readiness decisions.
  • Support product acceptance and release readiness by checking delivered functionality against agreed requirements and acceptance criteria.
  • Support the BI team by translating product questions, KPIs and tracking needs into clear data requirements.
  • Ensure agreed analytics requirements are captured as part of delivery, including relevant event tracking before work is considered complete.
  • Maintain clear and up-to-date product documentation in Jira and Confluence.


We look for

  • You are passionate about building products for LGBTQ+ communities and interested in contributing to the continued development of ROMEO.
  • You have initial experience in a Product Owner or similar product delivery role, ideally in a B2C environment. Experience in social, dating or community products is a plus. Being familiar with how our product works is a plus.
  • You have experience writing or refining user stories and acceptance criteria.
  • You have a good understanding of Agile product development and ideally hands-on experience with Scrum and/or Kanban.
  • You are comfortable working with Jira and Confluence. Experience with Xray is a plus.
  • You are organised, detail-oriented and reliable in following work through to completion.
  • You proactively follow up on missing information and drive requirements towards clarity.
  • You are based in Berlin or willing to relocate and are happy to work from our Wittenbergplatz office at least three days per week.
  • You have excellent written and spoken English skills, ideally at a native or near-native level.


What We Offer

  • A hands-on role working on an established European digital product during a significant phase of product and technology transformation.
  • Close collaboration with Product, Design, Engineering, QA and BI,
  • Hybrid working (3 days per week in our Berlin office at Wittenbergplatz)
  • €40 employer contribution towards the Germany Job Ticket

An AI agent that runs a property transaction end to end only works if the data underneath it is available, reliable and governed. That is the job.

Why this role exists

This is the first dedicated data hire in years. The foundations run, the steering is up to you.

While BigQuery already houses most of our data, we still lack key Growth data and a cohesive data governance framework. We need unified definitions, a canonical schema, and a robust semantic layer, enabling Growth, Finance, Ops and Product to self-serve insights efficiently and reliably.

Today the stack holds because individuals across Ops, Growth, Finance and Engineering compensate locally. They learned the quirks and built workarounds. It works, but it is fragile: KPIs drift between tools, tracking breaks silently, costs escalate, and nobody owns the translation between raw engineering data and decision-ready truth.

You will be the single accountable owner of that layer. Not a support function, not a ticketing desk, not a BI factory.

What you will own

Canonical models and metric definitions. A documented semantic layer with canonical entities (Buyer, Seller, Asset, Agent) and Bronze / Silver / Gold layers. Clear contracts between what Engineering exposes and what each function consumes, so that KPI debates are aligned on the same metric.

Self-serve enablement. The submerged part of the iceberg: clean models, consistent BI primitives, row- and column-level security, so Ops, Growth, Finance and Account Managers build their own dashboards without compromising on accuracy.

Analytics and tracking governance. The global event taxonomy and tracking roadmap, a hybrid client-side and server-side event strategy, consistent sync across CRMs and marketing platforms, and GDPR consent flows by design, so acquisition spend runs on attribution we can trust.

Platform reliability, safety and cost. Standards set once rather than team by team: tested and versioned transformations, monitoring of freshness, failures and usage, sane ingestion patterns (read replicas, CDC, batch), and no production code path depending on BI tables.

Data and AI driving decisions. Our internal AI tooling already queries the data warehouse for analyses. What’s missing is the core foundation: standardized metric definitions, reusable logic, and pre-computed data models.

What success looks like after 12 months

  • One documented event taxonomy, actually used by Engineering, Growth and CRM.

  • One semantic layer where every shared KPI has a single definition, a single owner and a version history. New joiners understand the data model in days, not months.

  • Published freshness and failure SLAs, an explicit ingestion topology, and no production path depending on BI tables.

  • Ops, Growth, Finance and AMs build most of their recurring dashboards themselves, and AI agents query the data layer safely through curated MCPs.

  • Growth attribution is trustworthy enough that annual acquisition spend decisions are defensible end to end.

What we are looking for

  • 7+ years as a Data, Analytics or Platform Engineer, ideally including a stint at a fast-moving consumer or marketplace company. Staff or Lead exposure expected.

  • Hands-on with the modern data stack: BigQuery (or Snowflake, Redshift), dbt or equivalent, advanced SQL and data modeling, Python for pipelines, orchestration (Airflow, Dagster, Prefect).

  • You have shipped event tracking and instrumentation in production, end to end: taxonomy, client and server-side events, attribution, GDPR-compliant opt-out, propagation downstream.

  • Comfortable with ingestion patterns (Fivetran, Airbyte, CDC), reverse-ETL (Hightouch, Census, Segment), and access governance (IAM, row- and column-level security, PII tagging).

  • You have built and owned a semantic or metrics layer, and you can arbitrate metric definitions with Finance, Ops and Growth without flinching.

  • You treat AI agents as first-class data consumers: exposing data through MCPs, semantic APIs or text-to-SQL, with proper guardrails.

  • Strong ownership: you write the standards, defend them, and fix what is broken without waiting for permission.

  • A clear communicator who turns "ping the data person" rituals into self-serve handoffs.

  • Fluent in English and French.

The honest trade-off

There is no data team to manage, and none planned in the short term. You get real autonomy and a direct line to the founders and function leads, in exchange for building alone before maybe building a team. At a comparable proptech you would join an existing team and an existing roadmap. Here, what a metric means at Zefir is not decided yet, and you are the one who decides it.

About Upflow

 

Upflow is the Financial Relationship Management (FRM) platform that helps B2B finance teams collect smarter and get paid by their customers faster, with AI agents working alongside the team.

Today, the order-to-cash process is mission critical for businesses, yet it remains fragmented across tools, teams, and workflows. Upflow brings this entire process into one system — four products covering the cycle from invoice to cash (Insights, Collections, Payments, and Cash Application), with AI agents that work alongside the team and a shared intelligence layer underneath.

We serve 500+ companies across 30+ countries, including Vercel, Lattice, and Productboard, and are backed by leading investors including Y Combinator, Hedosophia, Hexa, and Lorimer. With teams across the US and Europe, we're building a category-defining company at the intersection of finance, payments, and AI.

To learn more about what we do, visit upflow.io. For a behind-the-scenes look at how we work as a team, head to the Inside Upflow section of our blog at upflow.io/blog/inside-upflow.

Your role at Upflow

 

As a Senior Product Designer, you'll define solutions that allow finance teams to experience consumer grade UX in their day to day lives.

  • Lead end-to-end design projects, work closely with engineers, product managers and other stakeholders to ensure a high-quality implementation

  • Create flows, prototypes, and high-fidelity visuals (we use Figma, Cursor and Claude)

  • Plan and run user research and usability tests

  • Own our design system to ensure efficient delivery of new features

  • Contribute to overall strategy and decision-making about product direction

  • Collaborate with Marketing on our brand design, ensuring our app and communications feel coherent

Who you are

  • 5+ years of experience in Product Design

  • Curiosity for people’s problems, and a drive to figure out best-in-class solutions for them

  • Track record of shipping high‑impact product work in B2B or complex workflows

  • You have embraced AI capabilities to craft your designs

  • A portfolio that clearly explains context, constraints, your decisions, and impact

  • You adhere to our operating principles

Why join us

Here what you’ll find at Upflow:

  • International Mindset: We have offices in Paris and New York.

  • Exciting moment: Opportunity to join early and contribute to the Design function from the ground up.

  • All-star team: Extremely solid team with deep functional and domain expertise.

  • Learning opportunity: Strong focus on learning and growing through education and professional development in hard and soft skills.

  • Trusting environment: Hands-off management style. We have a strong culture of ownership and autonomy.

  • Best in class perks: 35 paid days off, meal vouchers, cool offices, top-of-the-range equipment, great healthcare, and competitive salary and equity.

  • Offsites: Regular offsites with the team, meetups, and strong connections to the startup ecosystem

Recruitment process

1 - Screening call with JM, Product Director

It’s a discussion with your future manager. We’ll get deeper into your expertise and know-how. We’ll also give you a clearer view of what your day-to-day in that role is like. It’s a good opportunity to see if you foresee yourself working at Upflow.

 

2 - Home assignment

Your time to shine! You’ll be given a home assignment. Yes, it is designed to assess your skills. But it’s also designed to give you a better taste of what being part of Upflow is like. Again, hiring is a two-way street! Ultimately: we believe assignments are a great way to control our biases. We care for what you do; not your schooling, social background, or the gender you identify yourself to.

 

3 - Home assignment review

Your hiring manager will spend up to 60 minutes debriefing your case with you. A peer can take part in this review. Hiring managers at Upflow are looking for team players: taking and giving feedback is key to thriving with us!

 

4 - Meet the team

You'll meet with members of the team so you can foresee yourself as part of it 😃

 

5 - Founder interview

Meet with Alex (co-founder & CEO). He will tell you everything about Upflow’s vision and values. It’s a privileged moment to ask questions, too.

6 - Reference check

 

7 - Alignment & offer

If you’ve made it this far, chances are we like each other and it feels like Upflow is a place you can grow and shine over the next few years. We will align on the right way for you to come on board, and if successful in that process we will extend you an offer, and you can relax and get ready for your new job.

 

*****

 

Diversity & Inclusion

At Upflow, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage all individuals to apply, even if you don’t meet every qualification. Research shows that some candidates may hesitate to apply unless they meet every requirement. However, we believe that a variety of experiences and perspectives can bring value beyond the listed qualifications. If you’re excited about what we do and feel you could contribute, we want to hear from you.

The transition to a sustainable future requires discovering new mineral resources to power clean technologies and renewable energy solutions. From lithium for electric vehicle batteries, to copper for wind turbines, and rare earth elements for electronics, these minerals are the building blocks of our energy transition.

Lithosquare radically speeds up mineral exploration by combining foundational AI, geological expertise, and real-world data to reduce uncertainty, prioritize the right targets, reduce costs and accelerate discovery. Based in Paris, Lithosquare gathered an exceptional team of geologists, scientists, AI engineers, and data specialists to work as one, from field sampling to model optimization and push the boundaries of what's possible.

About the job

As a Geologist at Lithosquare, you will play a key hybrid role at the intersection of field operation (around 20%) and office work (80%). You will support field campaign execution while actively contributing to data compilation, targeting, and QA/QC across our exploration portfolio.

This is a dynamic, cross-functional role: you will divide your time between field work (reconnaissance, sampling, drilling support) and office work in Paris, working closely with senior geologists, data scientists, and AI engineers. We are looking for someone rigorous, curious about technological innovation, and eager to learn while helping build the next generation of AI-assisted exploration tools.

What you'll do

Reporting to the Senior Geologists and the VP Asset Development, your main responsibilities will include:

  • Field Execution & Support: Support and participate in all phases of field exploration programs, including regional reconnaissance, surface sampling, geophysical surveys, and drilling campaigns. Assist with field logistics while ensuring compliance with international health, safety, and environmental (HSE) standards.

  • Data Compilation & QA/QC: Lead geological data entry, compilation, and QA/QC processes to ensure the accuracy, consistency, and integrity of exploration datasets across all projects.

  • Office Work: Assist senior geologists with geological data interpretation to support exploration targeting, field campaign planning, technical reporting, GIS mapping, data management, and project evaluation. Contribute to the preparation of maps, presentations, and technical documentation.

  • Bridge Geology & AI Tech: Work closely with the tech and AI teams to test, refine, and improve Lithosquare’s AI platform, ensuring our digital tools reflect field realities and technical needs.

  • Reporting & Collaboration: Prepare clear technical summaries, data visualizations, and maps for internal reviews and partner updates.

What we are looking for

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in mineral exploration geology

  • Degree in Geology or Earth Sciences, with solid foundations in metallogeny, structural geology, or geochemistry

  • First significant field exposure (mapping, sampling, or core logging) with a willingness to spend significant time in the field as required by projects

  • Data-driven & Rigorous: A structured approach to data management, QA/QC, and documentation; familiarity with GIS software (QGIS, ArcGIS) and/or geological modeling software is a plus

  • Tech-curious & Innovative mindset: Genuine interest in how AI and technology can transform traditional exploration methods

  • Strong Communication: Ability to collaborate effectively in a multi-disciplinary team (geologists, data scientists, AI engineers), interact professionally with partners and produce clear, synthetic & high-quality deliverables

  • Fluency in English is required with previous exposure to international exchanges

ScorePlay is the AI-powered media infrastructure for sports, built to automate the content operations behind the world's biggest sports organizations. We work with 300+ leagues, competitions, teams and broadcasters – including Ligue 1 and Premier League clubs, NBA and NFL teams, the Tour de France, the Australian Open, and leading bodies like UEFA and FIBA – helping them turn every moment on and off the field into high-value, structured content. Our platform brings all their media into one place and makes it effortless to find, edit and share in seconds.

Founded in 2021, we’re a 50-person team based between New York and Paris, growing 2x year over year with 98% retention. We’ve raised $20M+ from top investors including Alexis Ohanian and Harry Stebbing’s 20VC and elite athletes like Kevin Durant, Raphaël Varane, Mario Götze, Nico Rosberg and Giannis Antetokounmpo.

If you’re passionate about sports and thrive in fast-paced environments - and you want to help shape how the next generation of fans experience sports, you’re in the right place. We’re on track to become the global leader in sports media, and this is definitely the best time to join our adventure.

 

Location: Hybrid from Paris or full remote

Role Overview

ScorePlay signs deals with some of the biggest organizations in sports, and every one of them starts with a contract. We are hiring a Commercial Contracts Counsel to own that: redlines, negotiations, signatures, the whole thing. You work directly with Lou, our General Counsel, and are the first point of contact for Sales on contracts.

What you will do

1. Contracts

  • You review, redline and negotiate the agreements that close our deals: MSAs, service agreements, order forms, SOWs, NDAs and DPAs, with clubs, leagues, federations, broadcasters and brands, often across several countries.

  • Sales comes to you when a deal is stuck on terms, and your job is to unstick it: fast turnaround, pragmatic fallbacks, and the judgement to know when a point is worth holding.

  • You partner with Sales, Finance, RevOps and Customer Success so contract terms match how the deal is actually priced, booked and delivered.

  • You take a share of vendor and partner agreements alongside Lou, split based on what is moving and where you want to build depth.

2. Tools, processes and enablement

  • We use AI heavily in contract work: drafting, first-pass reviews, summarizing counterparty terms. We want someone who genuinely enjoys this and keeps looking for a smarter way to handle the repetitive part.

  • Our legal playbook is young. You execute it, then you help Lou refine it with what you see in real negotiations.

3. Privacy and security

  • You contribute to customer security, privacy and vendor due-diligence questionnaires, and to DPA and international transfer questions. The heart of the role is contracts, with room to grow into broader compliance work if that interests you.

What we are looking for

  • You know commercial contracts inside out. 3 to 5 years of experience, most of it in-house, with contracts at the core of what you did.

  • You work autonomously. Give you an MSA or a set of customer redlines and you come back with a position, a fallback and a recommendation.

  • You ship fast. A solid answer today beats a perfect one on Friday, and you're comfortable making the call at 80% certainty.

  • You're resourceful. When something is unclear, you dig, you ask, you find a way, rather than waiting for perfect instructions.

  • You like helping people win. Supporting a Sales team means being responsive, available, and genuinely happy when a deal signs because of your work.

  • You're excited by AI. You already use it in your legal work, or you can't wait to, and you keep looking for smarter ways to handle the repetitive parts.

What’s fun about this role

  • You negotiate international contracts with some of the biggest names in sports: clubs, leagues, federations and broadcasters on every continent.

  • As our first commercial counsel, you own your function and you're the main partner of the Sales team on both sides of the Atlantic.

  • You sit in sales calls with senior stakeholders at major sports organizations, on deals worth USD 50k to 500k a year. When a deal closes, you're usually one of the key players who made it work.

  • Small team, short loops. You'll have the opportunity to bring ideas to the table, build playbooks, experiment with AI and new tools, and learn a ton along the way.

We know many people hesitate to apply if they don’t meet every single requirement on a job description. If you’re interested in ScorePlay but not sure you tick all the boxes, we’d still love to hear from you, this could be the start of a great long-term collaboration.

Every company that scales lives or dies by its procurement function. It manages the vendor relationships that keep operations running, the financial guardrails that prevent overspend, and the supply chain resilience that determines whether a company survives a crisis or folds under one. And yet, the people doing this work spend 80% of their time in spreadsheets. Not because they lack ambition, because the tools haven't changed in 25 years.


Pivot is building the AI operating system for procurement: enterprise-grade infrastructure that hands the manual grind to AI agents so procurement teams can do what they were actually hired to do, shape the strategic future of their companies. We've lived this frustration firsthand. We built Pivot because we couldn't find what we needed, and because we believe procurement shouldn't be the last function to enter the AI era. It should be the first.

We are seeking a highly skilled Location Data Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will work with large-scale datasets generated by our products and turn raw data into meaningful signals, insights, and features.

You will work across the entire data lifecycle: building reliable pipelines, exploring and understanding complex datasets, developing features from them, and creating the tools and visualizations needed to understand their quality and impact.

This is a technical and product-oriented data role. You'll collaborate closely with product, engineering, and data teams to find what we can learn from our data and turn those learnings into production systems.

As a Data Engineer, your day-to-day will include:

  • Making Sense of Data

    • Explore large and complex datasets to understand user behavior and identify useful patterns and signals.

    • Transform raw data into reliable, well-defined features that can be used by our products and engineering teams.

    • Develop a deep understanding of our data: where it comes from, what it represents, its limitations, and how it can be combined to answer new questions.

  • Building Data Products

    • Design, build, and maintain pipelines that process large volumes of data efficiently and reliably.

    • Take ideas from exploration to production: prototype them on historical data, evaluate their quality, and build the pipelines needed to run them at scale.

    • Build datasets and features that can power product experiences, internal systems, analytics, and machine learning models.

    • Work with technologies such as Spark, DBT, Dagster, BigQuery, ClickHouse, DuckDB, or similar tools depending on the problem at hand.

  • Exploring & Analyzing

    • Use data to investigate hypotheses, understand behaviors, and answer ambiguous questions.

    • Develop metrics and evaluation frameworks to understand whether the signals and features we build actually work.

    • Create analyses, dashboards, and visualizations that make complex datasets understandable and help the team make better decisions.

    • Build tooling that makes it easier to inspect individual examples, debug data pipelines, and understand why a system produces a particular result.

  • From Data to Intelligence

    • Work closely with engineers and product teams to identify opportunities where data can make our products smarter.

    • Use statistical methods, heuristics, experimentation, or machine learning depending on what is most appropriate for the problem.

    • Iterate on features and models based on real-world data and continuously improve their accuracy and reliability.

    • Help bridge the gap between exploratory data work and robust systems running in production.

  • Continuous Improvement

    • Improve the performance, reliability, and maintainability of our data infrastructure.

    • Monitor data quality and proactively investigate unexpected changes or anomalies.

    • Stay up to date with developments in data engineering, analytics, and machine learning, and bring relevant ideas and technologies into our stack.

    • Contribute to a culture of curiosity, craftsmanship, and learning.

Your Skills & Experience

  • Familiarity with data modeling, pipeline orchestration, and large-scale data processing.

  • Ability to communicate findings clearly through metrics, visualizations, dashboards, or other tools.

We're looking for an ambitious, growth-obsessed Content Specialist who basically thinks in TikToks. Someone who gets fired up by great content, knows what's trending before it trends, and wants to take Bump to #1 on the App Store in the UK (and keep it there).

You'll be the person bringing internet culture from the UK into the heart of our Paris office, creating content, leading creators, testing wild ideas, breaking things (in a good way), and helping us build Bump into a must-have app.

If that sounds like your dream job, keep reading.

You are:

  • Ambitious, driven, and wildly creative.

  • A natural storyteller who knows exactly why one video flops and another takes off.

  • Someone who spends more time on TikTok than you'd ever admit publicly.

  • Comfortable giving creators feedback that actually makes their content better.

  • Deeply tuned into British memes, humour, and online culture.

  • Fluent in English and lived in the UK.

  • Excited to work onsite in Paris, with a fast-moving team.

  • Scrappy, energetic, experimental, you love trying 10 ideas to find the 1 that blows up, yet rigorous and detail oriented.

What You’ll Do:

  • Grow Bump in the UK (yep, you'll actually own this).

  • Lead all content + creator efforts for the UK market.

  • Make high-performing TikToks, Reels, and UGC-style ads that people actually want to watch.

  • Build and manage a pipeline of British creators.

  • Run influencer campaigns with top British creators and micro-influencers.

  • Work closely with paid marketing to turn great content into great performance.

  • Jump on trends before they hit the For You Page.

  • Write briefs, give notes, and help external creators shine.

  • Collaborate daily in our Paris office with growth, distribution, and product.

  • Join brainstorms, test ideas fast, and help shape the creative direction of Bump.

  • Support launches, events, and UK-focused activations.

Requirements:

  • 1–5+ years making short-form content (brand, agency, influencer, or creator, we care more about your work than your title).

  • Experience making content for ads (UGC especially).

  • Experience managing creators or giving creative feedback.

  • Deep knowledge of TikTok/IG trends and the British creator landscape.

  • English language proficiency.

  • Experience living in the UK.

  • Must be willing to work in person in Paris.

Why Join Bump?

  • Work in Paris with an ambitious, high-energy team that moves fast.

  • Own the entire UK market for one of the world's fastest-growing consumer apps.

  • Make content seen by millions and watch your work directly drive growth.

  • Do the kind of creative work most companies would never let you try.

  • Build a content engine from scratch and shape how Bump shows up in the UK.

  • We test fast, learn fast, and celebrate wins properly.

data.description:
About the role

Imagine owning the quality backbone of an aerospace company moving at full speed. While innovation accelerates around you, you ensure every design and every process meets the highest standards without slowing the momentum. As the Engineering Quality Manager, you will ensure that our engineering Organisation (including the Design Organization (DO)) maintains compliance with applicable standards and best practices (like EASA Part 21 Subpart J, EN9100). You’ll lead the development and oversight of our quality system, manage design supplier qualification and monitoring, drive internal and external audits and continuous improvement across all design, qualification and certification activities.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You´ll Do

  • Be responsible for establishing, documenting, developing and managing the Quality System and for ensuring that it continues to comply with regulatory requirements and business needs.
  • Support and guide our Engineering departments in the definition and implementation of efficient processes.
  • Oversee design supplier qualification, categorization, and ongoing performance monitoring.
  • Maintain and enhance the quality system, including document control, change management, and compliance monitoring
  • Monitor compliance of internal processes with established industry standards and certification authority requirements (such as EN9100, EASA Part 21J and required military standards).
  • Plan, conduct, and document internal and external audits in line with established processes.
  • Track and follow up on audit findings and corrective actions.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders and external auditors (e.g., EASA, MoD), and cross-functional teams to ensure compliance and quality standards are met.

Requirements

What You’ll Need

  • 7+ years in military or civil aviation or aerospace quality and compliance, or other highly quality driven industries such as automotive, energy with hands-on experience in the aviation industry
  • Experience with supplier quality management.
  • Track record in leading quality investigations, undertaking root cause analysis, developing corrective action plans, and ensuring the effectiveness of actions undertaken.
  • Audit training/certification or experience setting up  ISO 9001, AS9100, AQAP2110 quality systems required.
  • Familiarity with EASA Part 21 Subpart J and industry certification standards (e.g., DO-178C, DO-254, STANAGs).
  • Strong communication, analytical, and cross-functional collaboration skills

Who You Are

You are naturally detail obsessed but never lose sight of the bigger picture. You combine regulatory sharpness with practical engineering judgment and you know when to challenge and when to enable. Calm under pressure, you bring structure to complexity and clarity to ambiguity. You are assertive without ego, collaborative without compromising standards. When something is not compliant, you speak up. When a process can be better, you improve it.

Imagine this. You are helping build the electronic foundation behind advanced aerospace and defence systems, making sure every component, symbol, footprint, and schematic detail is accurate before it reaches hardware.

As an Engineering Intern, you will work hands-on with Altium Designer and support our electronics engineers in creating and maintaining high-quality PCB design data. This is an opportunity to move beyond university projects and work with real engineering hardware where precision and attention to detail matter.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You'll Do

  • Create, review, and maintain electronic components, schematic symbols, footprints, and library data in Altium Designer
  • Read schematics and component datasheets to ensure design data accurately reflects manufacturer specifications
  • Support engineers with PCB design activities and help maintain clean, consistent, and reliable component libraries
  • Check existing components for errors, inconsistencies, and missing information before they make their way into hardware
  • Help improve library management, component validation, and engineering workflows
  • Use scripting and automation where useful to make repetitive checks faster and more reliable

Requirements

  • Currently studying toward a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, or a related field, or recently graduated
  • Hands-on experience with Altium Designer through university projects, personal PCB designs, or previous internships
  • Comfortable with schematic capture, library editors, and creating your own symbols and footprints
  • Ability to read schematics and datasheets, with a solid understanding of packages, pinouts, passive components, and common ICs
  • Strong attention to detail and a structured approach to technical work
  • Good written and spoken English
  • Experience with Altium 365 or another managed library environment is a plus
  • Familiarity with IPC-7351 footprint standards is an advantage
  • Basic Python or similar scripting experience for automation and bulk checks is a plus
  • Exposure to component lifecycle or obsolescence management is an advantage

Who You Are

You are curious, precise, and hands-on. You enjoy getting into the details and understand that a tiny mistake in a component library can become a very real hardware problem later. You work methodically, ask questions when something does not look right, and are excited to learn from experienced engineers while taking real ownership from day one.

data.description:
The Context

Banks still run their most critical, regulated work by hand; reading letters and emails, re-keying data between systems, chasing down missing info. It's the kind of work that's too important to get wrong and too tedious for anyone to want to do.

Porters fixes this. Our AI agents run these regulated processes end to end, with the audit trails and security banks actually require, so the work moves at the speed customers expect instead of the speed a backlog allows.

We're just over a year old and already live with real customers, growing the product quickly, and were named Fintech of the Year 2026. The goal is to build the operating system for autonomous banking. We're backed by Earlybird, one of Europe's oldest venture firms, and Seedcamp, who wrote first checks into Revolut, Wise, and UiPath.

The Mission

You'll own features in their entirety. Self-standing or with guidance of founders and fellow engineers, you turn a clear problem statement into a strong design and build, test, and ship new features that directly enable our customers. You integrate features across our layered stack, from the API to the data plane, and carry them all the way to production.

This job is in person in Zurich, or remote in Barcelona or Berlin.

Your responsibilities

  • Ship features end-to-end: Deliver complete vertical slices across the stack, from the API layer to the data model, carried through to running in production.

  • Grow what the platform does for banks: Build the services Porters performs for banks: Extend the capabilities of our agentic platform such as case handling, customer matching, AI tool integrations, data enrichment, or keeping humans in the loop.

  • Deliver features that hold together as a system: Design endpoints, contracts, and interfaces that work together, ensuring features integrate cleanly towards one bigger outcome.

  • Ensure your work is reliable: Own design, development, tests, and deployment, so what reaches production is proven to work.

  • Wow our customers: You solve for the customer's actual problem, not just the request and measure success by customer outcomes. What would it take for the customer to say “Porters, made my day”.

Your profile

  • Experience: Around 4 years of professional software engineering, with a track record of shipping in fast-paced, ambiguous environments. Regulated industry and/or VC-backed startup experiences are a plus.

  • Product thinking: You naturally understand why you’re building something, not just focusing on how to build.

  • Quality focus & individual problem solving: Given a clear problem, you reliably produce a clean algorithm, a sensible data model, a well-structured service. You treat tests and observability as part of the feature, and right-size rigor to risk. You are comfortable in a regulated fintech environment where precision matters.

  • Technical proficiency: Proficiency in Python is mandatory, along with REST API development, an ORM, and relational databases.

  • AI-native: You've worked with, or are eager to work with, LLM/agentic tooling, and understand how to bound probabilistic output with deterministic code.

  • Collaboration and eagerness to learn: You thrive on direction, review, and challenge, take feedback well, and want to grow into larger scopes. You are eager to learn every day.

  • Going the extra mile: Be part of a high-growth phase, where we move fast and expect focused intensity. 9-to-5 is not the mode we work in, if you want to build something that matters with a team that ships, we are your people.

What We Offer

  • Ownership from day one: Real features running in production at major financial institutions, with the trust to carry them there yourself.

  • Founder collaboration: Work directly with founders who have built and scaled fintech and analytics products before.

  • We win and lose together as a team: We expect people to leave their comfort zone on a daily basis, however, we work together as a team and support each other at any time.

  • Growth: A dedicated development budget, free to use for whatever gives you a level-up.

Culture: Strong focus on a healthy, high-performance team culture, ranging from regular team events and dinners to an inclusive, fast-paced team that grows together.

Our stack

  • Core Backend: Python 3.14, FastAPI, Pydantic, and SQLAlchemy 2.0 in a strict four-layer architecture, exposed as separate internal and external APIs.

  • Background processing: Containerized worker services and event-driven AWS Lambda orchestrators for email ingestion, document triaging, and action running.

  • AI Integration: AI orchestration deeply integrated into application landscape via AWS Bedrock, e.g., to extract information and drive agentic activity.

  • Data & Storage: Per-tenant Aurora MySQL in isolated subnets, S3 for document persistence, and an append-only ledger for auditability.

  • Platform: A multi-tenant AWS environment on ECS Fargate with strict per-tenant network and data isolation (VPC, NACLs, WAF), CloudFront + Cognito (Google SSO/JWT) and API Gateway (IAM) at the edge, defined as code in CloudFormation across dev/staging/prod accounts.

  • Frontend: React single-page app for the internal workbench.

  • Dev Workflow: uv, Ruff, ty, pytest (unit, integration, property-based), Docker, GitHub Actions, and heavy use of Agentic IDEs to accelerate feature shipping.

  • Deliver the highest-risk work yourself: Be the IC where it matters. Personally engineer the most complex, business-critical components, from cross-service logic to the boundary where AI outputs become deterministic, auditable actions, and set the technical bar for the team as you go.

  • Turn business goals into shipped projects: Take an ambiguous problem and own it through to delivery, defining requirements, a design that starts from customer impact and takes the highest-ROI path whether it's make or buy, sequenced work, estimates, and clear engineering acceptance criteria a team can execute with minimal churn.

  • Design complex systems that don’t break down in 12 months: Architect entire systems so the likely next requirement plugs in cleanly through configuration or a new adapter, keeping components reusable and loosely coupled, separating business logic from shared services, and maintaining a single authoritative, append-only source of truth for critical data - including consideration of make-or-buy options.

  • Scale the team's autonomy and quality: Set decision thresholds so engineers self-serve low-stakes calls, define sanctioned paths for experimenting with regulated data, and spread understanding of our systems to cut key-person risk. Settle design in review, then build the road to production: CI/CD with quality gates, automated migrations, and systems that report their own health.

  • Wow our customers: You solve for the customer's actual problem, not just the request, and measure success by customer outcomes. What would it take for the customer to say “Porters made my day!”?

Your profile

  • Experience: Typically 8+ years of professional software engineering, with a track record of shipping in fast-paced, ambiguous environments. Regulated industry and/or VC-backed startup experiences are a plus.

  • IC strength: A hands-on builder who ships the hard things, and who naturally thinks in business outcomes, work packages, ROI, and extensibility.

  • Project definition: Proven ability to write requirements and designs from business context, break them into estimated, sequenced work, and drive a project to completion in a tool like Linear.

  • Technical proficiency: Deep proficiency in Python is mandatory, with strong command of REST API design, relational data modeling, and layered, service-oriented architecture.

  • AI-native: Real experience building LLM/agentic tooling, and understanding how to bound probabilistic output with deterministic code.

  • Natural leader: You lift the people around you through design review, coaching, and clear direction, and you enjoy doing it.

  • Going the extra mile: Be part of a high-growth phase, where we move fast and expect focused intensity. 9-to-5 is not the mode we work in, if you want to build something that matters with a team that ships, we are your people.

What We Offer

  • Ownership of whole product areas: Latitude to shape what we build and how we scope, sequence, and ship it, with a team to build it with.

  • Founder collaboration: Work directly with founders who have built and scaled fintech and analytics products before.

  • We win and lose together as a team: We expect people to leave their comfort zone on a daily basis, however, we work together as a team and support each other at any time.

  • Growth: A dedicated development budget, free to use for whatever gives you a level-up.

  • Culture: Strong focus on a healthy, high-performance team culture, ranging from regular team events and dinners to an inclusive, fast-paced team that grows together.

Our stack

  • Core Backend: Python 3.14, FastAPI, Pydantic, and SQLAlchemy 2.0 in a strict four-layer architecture, exposed as separate internal and external APIs.

  • Background processing: Containerized worker services and event-driven AWS Lambda orchestrators for email ingestion, document triaging, and action running.

  • AI Integration: AI orchestration deeply integrated into application landscape via AWS Bedrock, e.g., to extract information and drive agentic activity.

  • Data & Storage: Per-tenant Aurora MySQL in isolated subnets, S3 for document persistence, and an append-only ledger for auditability.

  • Platform: A multi-tenant AWS environment on ECS Fargate with strict per-tenant network and data isolation (VPC, NACLs, WAF), CloudFront + Cognito (Google SSO/JWT) and API Gateway (IAM) at the edge, defined as code in CloudFormation across dev/staging/prod accounts.

  • Frontend: React single-page app for the internal workbench.

  • Dev Workflow: uv, Ruff, ty, pytest (unit, integration, property-based), Docker, GitHub Actions, and heavy use of Agentic IDEs to accelerate feature shipping.

data.description:
Get to know us

Ideals is a global B2B SaaS product company recognized as the most highly rated and customer-centric brand in the secure business collaboration market. Trusted by over 2,000,000 users from 300,000 companies globally, we help people run high-stakes processes and make important decisions with less stress, higher quality, and shorter hours.

Ideals Virtual Data Room (VDR): Secure document sharing and collaboration for due diligence, fundraising, corporate reporting, licensing, clinical trials, and other complex transactions.

The role

To support the rapid expansion of the Ideals VDR line of business in Zurich, we are looking for a Business Development Manager / Enterprise Account Executive to focus on our Corporate segment. Unlike our advisory-focused motions, you will sell directly to a wide variety of enterprise corporations across diverse industries (such as energy, pharma, biotech, and telecommunications).

As a quota-carrying strategic seller, your primary goal will be to grow sales and revenue through the acquisition of new strategic enterprise accounts and the expansion of existing ones. You will act as an impactful industry expert, generating demand, navigating complex 6 to 9-month sales cycles, and displacing incumbents by utilizing deep discovery and consultative selling frameworks.

Compensation package: 50% base salary; 50% performance-based variable.

Why Ideals?

  • High trust from sales peers: Ideals ranks among the Top-10% of companies on RepVue, as rated by sales professionals. Great Place To Work® Certified in the UK and the US (2026). You’ll join a team of 20+ teammates in the DACH region.

  • Growth opportunity: Accelerate your growth with a bootstrapped SaaS that's scaled revenue 4x (5x more projected in the next 5 years) with our flagship VDR product.

  • Proven track record: Be part of an established org with over 18 years in the VDR business, 30% + YoY revenue growth, powering 10%+ of global M&A activity.

What you will do

  • Proactively build and manage a pipeline focused on the acquisition of new strategic enterprise accounts (new logos)

  • Conduct solution-based sales engagements, including client meetings, executive presentations, and product demonstrations (face-to-face and virtual)

  • Maintain "White Space" analysis and execute strategic initiatives to upsell and cross-sell within the existing customer base

  • Develop and deliver comprehensive business cases that quantify the cost of inaction and address customer priorities, pain points, and ROI

  • Structure, negotiate, and close complex deals, guiding corporate clients step-by-step through enterprise procurement, security compliance, and legal processes

  • Orchestrate multi-threading strategies to navigate enterprise politics, establishing strong relationships with C-Suite executives and key stakeholders across various verticals

  • Keep an accurate track record of personal sales activities in the CRM, including methodical mid- and long-term forecasting

  • Provide relevant customer feedback to the product development team and collaborate with Customer Success, Marketing, and Inbound Sales to maximize revenue and customer satisfaction

What you bring

  • 4–7 years of demonstrable quota-carrying success in B2B sales

  • Proven track record of managing lengthy or complex enterprise sales cycles

  • Significant experience selling directly to C-level executives (CxOs) and multi-threading within large enterprise organizations

  • Clear understanding of, and practical experience with, consultative sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDIC/MEDPIC, SPIN, Challenger)

  • 4-year university degree (bachelor's)

  • Exceptional business communication skills, enabling you to execute executive storytelling, challenge the status quo, and handle complex contracting negotiations

  • High learning agility, analytical thinking, and commercial curiosity to quickly grasp the nuances of various corporate industries

  • High AI fluency and advanced CRM tracking skills

  • Native-level proficiency in German

  • C1 level in English

Nice to have

  • Fluency in an additional language

  • Background in SaaS, financial technology, or information security sectors

  • Familiarity with enterprise M&A use cases and corporate compliance workflows

Our assessment process

  • Screening call with the Talent Acquisition Specialist (40 mins)

  • Hiring Manager interview & Cold Call Role-Play (60 mins)

  • Discovery Role-Play Presentation with the Hiring Manager (60 mins - requires preparation beforehand to build a business case for a target Fortune 500 company)

  • Competency-based interview (CBI) (60 mins)

What we offer

We highly value our people, so we will empower you with all the resources and support to help you reach your full potential.

For your best work

  • Remote-first flexibility to shape your ideal workday

  • Home workplace budget

  • Co-working expense coverage

  • Individual IT budget for extra equipment

  • Top-tier tech and AI-powered tools

For your growth

  • Access to Ideals Academy with numerous courses

  • Investment in external learning and development activities

  • Guidance in Personal Development Plan creation

  • Professional literature and subscription coverage

  • Support of your passion as a speaker or writer

  • Internal talent mobility opportunities

For your well-being

  • Tailored Wellness Package for your physical and mental health

  • Funding for sports competitions

  • 25 business days of paid time off per year

  • Paid health-related time off

Extra perks

  • Budget for meetups with your local team

  • Generous internal referral program

Our culture

Commitment, Excellence, Collaboration, Trust and Care are core values to the Ideals team. For us, these are the principles that every Idealer lives and breathes. We are on the lookout for like-minded individuals who share our values. By doing so, we create a team where talents feel at ease and work to the best of their abilities.

Discover more.

Ideals is an equal opportunity employer

Ideals is made up of people from a wide variety of backgrounds and lifestyles. We embrace diversity and invite applications from people from all walks of life. We don’t discriminate against employees or applicants based on gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, religion, age, national origin, or citizenship.

data.description:
Join our Data & Analytics team at Crypto Finance, headquartered in the Prime Tower in Zurich. Your primary mandate is pushing the company’s AI strategy forward: identifying use cases across departments, engineering production-grade AI and automation solutions, and helping to build the firm's AI governance practice. You will also contribute to the data platform that underpins Finance, Operations, and Risk reporting, since AI work at our company sits directly on top of that platform. 

This is a hybrid role for someone who is equally comfortable in a stakeholder workshop and an IDE. The work potentially spans AI agents and copilots, deterministic automation, RAG systems, and the data infrastructure they rely on. You will be expected to push back on bad use cases as much as you ship good ones. 

What you will do: 

AI & Automation Engineering 

  • Work with stakeholders across Compliance, Trading, Operations, Legal, Sales, and Finance to identify, scope, and prioritize use cases that genuinely move the needle. 
  • Engineer production data solutions: Deterministic automations, AI agents, RAG systems over internal documents, structured extraction pipelines. 
  • Build the firm's "innovation lab" environment where new use cases can be prototyped and evaluated. 
  • Maintain prompt and skill libraries as reusable, version-controlled assets, not as one-off scripts. 

AI Governance and Inventory 

  • Maintain the firm-wide inventory of AI systems and use cases, including those built outside D&A. 
  • Run the operational side of the company’s AI approval process: documentation, risk classification, model cards, evaluation artifacts. Policy is set at the executive level; you make sure the operational practice meets it. 
  • Conduct technical review of new AI initiatives proposed elsewhere in the company; advise on scope, risk, and design choices. 

Data Engineering and Platform 

  • Contribute to ELT pipelines on the Dagster + SQLMesh + dlt stack, primarily where AI & automation use cases require new data sources or transformations. 
  • Build the data substrate that AI workloads consume; feature views, document indexes, and structured event tables.  
  • Maintain infrastructure as code in Git with proper review and deployment standards. 

 

Requirements

  • 3–6 years of relevant experience. We are flexible on title, could be AI engineer, analytics engineer with AI focus, or data engineer who is pivoted to AI. What matters is shipped work. 
  • Demonstrable production experience with LLM applications: at minimum structured extraction with LLMs, and agentic patterns (tool use, multi-step workflows). You can describe what failed and what you learned. 
  • Strong Python; comfortable building production ready code, not just notebooks. 
  • Working knowledge of evaluation discipline for LLM applications (eval sets, regression tests, observability), conceptual understanding of retrieval, and how to handle hallucination. 
  • Familiarity with at least one orchestrator (Dagster, Airflow, Prefect) and one transformation framework (SQLMesh, dbt). 
  • Solid SQL (window functions, joins, query design). 
  • Cloud experience, ideally GCP and BigQuery. 
  • Genuine curiosity about regulated environments and the discipline they require. 
  • Professional proficiency in English (German is a plus). 
  • Eligibility to work in Switzerland (Swiss permit or EU/EFTA citizenship). 

Equally important is how you think: 

  • You reach for the simplest thing that works. Boring SQL before vector search. Rules before agents. You can explain why. 
  • You are comfortable saying "this is not an AI problem" when the right answer is a dashboard, a process fix, or a deterministic script. 
  • You can run a stakeholder workshop and write production code in the same week. 
  • You take documentation, evaluation, and audit trails seriously, not as overhead. 

Nice to have: 

  • Prior exposure to regulated financial services, crypto, or comparable model-risk environments. 

What we are not looking for: 

  • "Prompt engineers" with no production experience. 
  • Pure data engineers using this posting to pivot into AI without prior LLM work. 
  • Strategists or generalist "AI enthusiasts." This is a builder role. 

Benefits

  • Be part of an international, fast-paced blockchain and fintech team led by experienced professionals
  • Shape the future of finance while working at the cutting edge of B2B digital asset solutions
  • Contribute to a collaborative, entrepreneurial culture with flat hierarchies
  • Take on meaningful responsibility with room for learning and professional growth
  • Gain deep industry insights and make a tangible impact
  • Join regular company-wide meetings, knowledge-sharing sessions, and team events
  • Enjoy a modern and central workplace in Zurich with top-tier infrastructure

Our culture

At the heart of our company, we prioritize:

  • Innovation and Continuous Learning
  • Collaboration and Knowledge Sharing
  • Entrepreneurial Spirit and Flat Hierarchies
  • Values such as Excellence, Delivery, Ownership, Passion, and Unity

Please note:

  • We do not accept CVs from recruiting or staffing agencies.
  • Due to the Swiss/German labor legislation, we can only accept applicants who have the right to work in Switzerland or Germany (are in possession of a Swiss/German work permit or are EU/EFTA citizens). All other applications will not be considered.
  • If this is the position for you, and you have a Swiss/German work permit and/or EU citizenship, please send us your complete application, incl. cover letter, CV, and references.

The company is driven by a constant pursuit of innovation, expanding its product suite to create integrated HR solutions for businesses from fledgling startups to global enterprises.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for an HR & EOR Operations Manager to join our Swiss entity on a part-time basis. This is a hands-on operational role - not a purely administrative or advisory position.

As part of the role, you will serve as the named Responsible Person for the Swiss entity under SECO/Zürich personnel leasing law, fulfilling a standing legal obligation tied to our EOR licence. This means you must be genuinely employed, operationally involved, and present in Switzerland - not an external adviser lending a name to a form.

Day-to-day workload is manageable within a 50% FTE, and you will be fully supported by the company's global HR, payroll and compliance teams. Other concurrent work or mandates are welcome, provided they do not interfere with your availability and supervision of the entity's activities.

This role is a strong fit for HR or EOR professionals already freelancing, holding consulting mandates, or looking to add a substantive part-time role to their portfolio.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Act as the named Responsible Person for the Swiss entity under Swiss personnel leasing (SECO) law.

  • Ensure compliance with Swiss labour-leasing legislation, Swiss employment law, and the staffing industry GAV (minimum wages and equal treatment).

  • Maintain documentation required for SECO and cantonal audits and inspections.

  • Serve as the primary Swiss contact for SECO and cantonal authorities.

  • Oversee HR and employment operations for the Swiss entity - including onboarding, contract controls, and employment matters.

  • Support payroll oversight in collaboration with the global payroll team.

  • Handle employee and client escalations related to HR and compliance matters.

  • Supervise the entity's EOR/personnel leasing activities and ensure they are conducted properly.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Right to Work in Switzerland - one of the following is required:

  • Swiss citizen.

  • EU/EFTA national with a current Swiss B or C permit.

  • Non-EU/EFTA national with a Swiss C permit (a non-EU/EFTA B permit alone does not qualify).

  • EU/EFTA national with a genuine 5-year cross-border G permit.

Education:

Any completed qualification - EFZ apprenticeship, Matura/Abitur, or university degree in any field.

Experience - either route qualifies:

Standard route:

3+ years in one of the following: recruitment or placement, personnel leasing or staffing (including EOR), substantive HR (not admin-only), personnel consulting, or organisational/business consulting. Employment certificates confirming dates, workload percentage and substantive duties are required alongside a CV.

Alternative route:

3+ years of general professional experience plus a completed, recognised HR qualification with a passed exam (e.g. HRSE or VSH HR Assistant). Course attendance without a final certificate does not count.

Character:

Clean criminal record, debt-enforcement register and tax history.

Other:

  • Comfortable being named on the Commercial Register with signing authority.

  • Willing to disclose other jobs, board mandates or licensed-business responsibilities.

  • Genuinely hands-on - purely advisory profiles (external lawyers or accountants with no operational involvement) are not suitable.

WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE DIFFERENT

This is a rare opportunity for an experienced HR or EOR professional in Switzerland to take on a meaningful operational role at a global scale without committing to a full-time position.

You will hold a real and recognised legal position within the Swiss entity, with direct contact with SECO and cantonal authorities, while being backed by an experienced international HR, payroll and compliance team.

The 50% structure makes this accessible to consultants, freelancers and professionals looking to add a substantive part-time engagement alongside existing work. International EOR or HR experience is fully valid - experience does not need to be Swiss-based, though familiarity with Swiss employment law and social insurance is an advantage.

The company values a builder mentality - people who want to improve processes, not just maintain them.

WORKING ENVIRONMENT

  • Fully remote within Switzerland.

  • Part-time 50% FTE with flexible hours.

  • Direct collaboration with the global HR, payroll and compliance teams.

  • Meaningful presence in Switzerland required (~50% benchmark) - remote-only offshore oversight does not meet regulatory requirements.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Health insurance contributions.

  • Share incentives.

  • Learning and mentorship opportunities.

  • Team offsites and social events.

  • 4 weeks of work-from-anywhere per year.

  • Other concurrent work or mandates are welcome.

Am Standort Schweiz entwickelt Signode innovative Umreifungsmaschinen und Verpackungslösungen für globale industrielle Anwendungen. Dabei werden Mechanik, Elektrotechnik, Softwareentwicklung und Systemtechnik miteinander verbunden.

Der Zweck dieser Position besteht in der Entwicklung moderner Systemkomponenten (Hard- und Software) innerhalb der Entwicklungsabteilung sowie deren Integration in bestehende Maschinen, Systemstrukturen und Steuerungssysteme. Die Rolle erfordert ein ganzheitliches Systemverständnis und eine enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Bereichen Konstruktion, Softwareentwicklung, Systems Engineering, Einkauf, Montage und Kundendienst.

Highlights:

  • Eine angenehme 40-Stunden-Woche

  • Flexibles Arbeitszeitmodell

  • Ein kostenloser Parkplatz direkt vor der Tür

  • 100%-ige Übernahme der Unfall- und Krankentaggeldversicherungsprämien für Ihre Sicherheit

  • Ein Gehalt, das Ihr volles Engagement angemessen belohnt

  • Für den perfekten Energiekick: kostenloses Kaffeeangebot

  • Subventionierte Kantinenverpflegung: täglich frisch vor Ort zubereitetes Znüni- und Mittagessenangebot

Werden Sie Teil des globalen Teams und gestalten Sie Ihre Karriere in einem Umfeld, in dem nicht nur professionelle Erfolge, sondern auch persönliche Entfaltung zählt! Folgende zusätzliche Verantwortungen gestalten ebenfalls Ihren neuen Arbeitsalltag mit:

  • Unterstützung der Serienproduktion bei Optimierung, Parametrierung und Fehlerbehebung

  • Inbetriebnahme, Parametrierung, Optimierung und Abnahme von Systemkomponenten einschliesslich Fehleranalyse, Upgrades und technischem Kundensupport

  • Mitwirkung bei globalen Rollout- und Integrationsprojekten (EPLAN, Siemens S7 / TIA Portal, Allen Bradley)


Bringen Sie zudem folgende Erfahrungen und Fähigkeiten mit, sind vielleicht genau Sie das passende Teammitglied:

  • Abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung mit Weiterbildung auf FH- oder HF-Niveau in Automatisierungs- oder Systemtechnik mit entsprechender Berufserfahrung

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in der industriellen Automatisierungs- und Steuerungstechnik

  • Branchenkenntnisse in der industriellen Elektrotechnik, zu gängigen Herstellern sowie relevanten IEC-, ISO- und EN-Normen

  • Kenntnisse in der Antriebstechnik

  • Gute SPS-Programmierkenntnisse (Siemens S7 / TIA Portal, Allen Bradley)

  • Sicherer Umgang mit EPLAN (EN 60204-1)

  • Vertiefte Normenkenntnisse (Maschinenrichtlinie 2006/42/EG, EN ISO 13849, EN 60204-1 resp. Maschinenverordnung 2023/1230)

  • Erfahrung mit PL-Berechnungen und Risikobeurteilungen

  • Kenntnisse industrieller Kommunikationssysteme (Profinet, Ethernet/IP)

  • Erfahrung in Inbetriebnahme und technischem Kundensupport

  • Kenntnisse in Elektronik und Mikroprozessorprogrammierung (μP)

About cogify group

cogify was founded in Switzerland in 2018 and today combines expertise in consulting, AI, software engineering, cybersecurity and digital products.

We are expanding our cybersecurity capabilities and are looking for a Cybersecurity Engineer with a strong interest in Zero Trust who understands how modern IT environments work and can turn security requirements into reliable technical solutions.

Your Mission

As a Cybersecurity Engineer, you work at the interface between security, infrastructure, cloud and delivery.

You understand how identities, devices, applications and networks interact, identify security weaknesses and implement controls that reduce risk without unnecessarily slowing down the business.

You work closely with our cybersecurity architects and engineering teams – from technical design and technology evaluation through configuration, integration, testing and production.

Requirements

Your Responsibilities

  • Implement and integrate Zero Trust security solutions
  • Configure and improve IAM, MFA, SSO, conditional access and least-privilege controls
  • Implement ZTNA, SASE, network segmentation and secure connectivity
  • Secure cloud, hybrid and on-premise environments
  • Implement endpoint, network, identity and workload security controls
  • Integrate identity providers, applications and security platforms
  • Configure, test and optimise security technologies
  • Analyse security issues and support remediation and troubleshooting
  • Improve security monitoring, logging and detection capabilities
  • Automate security configurations and controls where it creates value
  • Document technical solutions, configurations and security controls
  • Work closely with cybersecurity architects, cloud, infrastructure, DevOps and software teams
  • Support customer projects from technical design through implementation

Your Profile

  • Experience in cybersecurity engineering, network security, cloud security, infrastructure security or a comparable technical role
  • Good understanding of Zero Trust principles and modern cybersecurity technologies
  • Hands-on experience in one or more areas such as IAM, ZTNA, SASE, network security, segmentation, cloud security, endpoint security or access control
  • Good understanding of enterprise networks, identity, authentication and cloud environments
  • Experience implementing, integrating, configuring or operating security technologies
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills
  • Ability to understand technical requirements and turn them into reliable implementations
  • Hands-on mindset and curiosity for new security technologies
  • Independent and quality-focused way of working
  • Fluent English or German is required

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, Defender, Sentinel, Palo Alto, Fortinet, Cisco, Cloudflare, CrowdStrike or similar technologies
  • Experience with Azure, AWS or Google Cloud
  • Experience with PowerShell, Python, Terraform, Ansible or Infrastructure-as-Code
  • Knowledge of NIST, CIS, ISO 27001 or Zero Trust frameworks
  • Relevant cybersecurity certifications
  • German, French or other languages in addition to your primary working language

Benefits

Why cogify?

At cogify, cybersecurity is closely connected to engineering.

You work on real environments and help turn security architecture into solutions that run in production.

You will work alongside cybersecurity architects as well as our cloud, infrastructure, DevOps, software and AI teams, giving you the opportunity to deepen your expertise across different technologies and customer environments.

We offer a competitive salary, a flexible working environment, modern technologies and the opportunity to take real ownership of your work.

We are looking for people who understand technology, enjoy solving difficult problems and want to build security that works in practice.

Sound like you? We look forward to meeting you.

  • Ability to translate complex security topics into clear decisions and practical solutions
  • Confident communication with both business and technical stakeholders
  • Independent, pragmatic and quality-focused way of working
  • Fluent English or German is required

Nice to Have

  • Certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, SABSA, ISSAP or comparable qualifications
  • Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Palo Alto, Fortinet, Cisco, Cloudflare, CrowdStrike or similar technologies
  • Experience with Azure, AWS or Google Cloud
  • Experience in regulated or security-sensitive environments
  • German, French or other languages in addition to your primary working language

Benefits

At cogify, cybersecurity doesn’t end with an assessment or presentation.

You work directly with customers on real security challenges and stay involved when architecture becomes implementation.

The role combines cybersecurity consulting, architecture and technology, while giving you the opportunity to work closely with our engineering teams and actively shape a growing cybersecurity capability.

We offer a competitive salary, a flexible working environment, modern technologies and the opportunity to take real ownership of your work.

We are looking for people who ask good questions, understand complex systems and want to build security solutions that work in practice.

Sound like you? We look forward to meeting you.
